description: PyMOL open-source v2.3.0 (Feb 2019; C++ extension + Python; setup.py written for Python 3.7 / distutils / NumPy 1.x) must build and run headless under Python 3.12 (no distutils) with NumPy >= 2, reproducing the reference numerical behaviour (atom counts, distances, DSS secondary structure, alignment RMSD, FASTA) and ray-traced PNG rendering.
